title: Protocol to select conformation-specific intracellular antibodies for targeted protein degradation in an engineered cell line
protocol: Plate 40,000 H2882 cells per well in a 24-well plate using 0.5 mL of RPMI supplemented with 10% FBS.
Transfect the cells with JetPRIME reagent and the plasmid(s) of choice after 24 hours.
Add 0.75 μg of DNA to 50 μL of JetPRIME buffer, vortex for 10 seconds, and centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 3 seconds.
Add 1.5 μL of JetPRIME reagent to the mixture, vortex again for 10 seconds, and centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 3 seconds.
Incubate the mixture at 22°C for 10 minutes.
Add the mix drop by drop onto the cells.
Change the medium with fresh medium after 4 hours.
Detach the cells 72 hours after transfection.
Aspirate the medium and wash with 0.5 mL of PBS.
Add 0.3 mL of trypsin and leave the cells at 37°C for 3–5 minutes until detached.
Add 0.7 mL of complete medium to resuspend the cells by pipetting up and down carefully.
Plate 1/50 (20 μL) of the resuspended cells, 1/150 (6.7 μL), and the rest in 10 mL of medium containing antibiotic at a determined concentration on 100 mm plates.
Change the medium every three to four days with fresh antibiotic-containing medium.
After 3 to 4 weeks, pick clones that appear as colonies when they are 3–6 mm large using sterile cloning cylinders.
Add 50 μL of trypsin and wait under the tissue culture hood for 3 to 5 minutes.
Pipette carefully up and down to detach cells.
Prepare a 96-well plate with 200 μL of complete medium containing antibiotics per well.
Transfer 50 μL of detached cells into one well of the 96-well plate.
Amplify clones by increasing culture surface area as needed, from 96-well to 48-well to 12-well plates.
Freeze aliquots (2 × 10^6 cells per vial) in liquid nitrogen once sufficient cell growth is achieved.
Check the expression and localization of the antigen in cells using immunofluorescence and western blot techniques.
Perform western blot analysis using anti-RHOB or anti-mCherry antibodies at a dilution of 1/500, incubated for 18 hours.
Lysed Wild-type (WT) and stable H2882 clones transfected with the H2B-mCherry-RHOBQ63L expression vector.
Analyzed lysates by western blot to check RHOB and mCherry expression using anti-RHOB and anti-mCherry antibodies.
Incubated α-Tubulin as a loading control for 1 hour at a dilution of 1/10,000.
Stained H2882 cells stably expressing histone H2B-mCherry, H2B-mCherry-RHOBQ63L, or H2B-mCherry-RHOBT19N with an anti-RHOB primary antibody and an Alexa-488 secondary antibody.
Used DAPI to stain DNA for localization studies.
Visualized mCherry directly in the red channel during immunofluorescence analysis.
Plate cells on a coverslip.
Fix the cells with 3.7% PFA the day after plating.
Permeabilize the cells.
Block the permeabilized cells.
Incubate the cells with mouse anti-RHOB primary antibody at a dilution of 1/50 for 3 hours at 22°C.
Incubate the cells with goat anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody at a dilution of 1/400 for 1 hour at 22°C.
Mount the coverslip on a slide using mounting medium containing DAPI (Mowiol).
Grow TG1 E. coli containing the modified pHEN2 vector from NaLi-H1 library in 100 mL of LB with ampicillin and 0.5% glucose for 5 h at 37°C until Optical Density (OD) ≈ 0.1–0.2.
Do not grow cultures for more than 16-18 hours to avoid OD exceeding 0.2.
Prepare high purity medium scale plasmid DNA from the culture using a midiprep kit.
Digest 2–3 μg of DNA with NcoI and NotI enzymes at 37°C for 2 hours.
Run a 1% agarose gel to separate the digested DNA fragments.
Purify the NcoI/NotI digested DNA (around 400 bp band) using a gel extract DNA purification kit.
Digest the entry vector pFBOX-X-IRES-MITO-GFP with NcoI and NotI enzymes.
Ligate the polyclonal pool of DNA fragments coding for antibodies into the pFBOX-X-IRES-MITO-GFP vector using T4 DNA ligase.
Transform competent DH5α bacteria or any cloning strain with the ligation mix.
Plate the transformed bacteria on several agar plates containing 100 μg mL−1 ampicillin.
Grow each bacterial colony overnight in a 96-well plate, one colony per well, in LB medium supplemented with 100 μg mL−1 of ampicillin.
Add 500 μL of 100% glycerol to each well the next day and mix thoroughly.
Store the 96-well plate containing the glycerol stock at −80°C.
Transfect polyclonal pool of single domain antibodies (sdAb) fused with FBOX domain and MITO-GFP reporter into H2882 cells expressing H2B-mCherry-RHOBQ63L mutant for 48 hours.
Observe transfected cells using an inverted epifluorescence microscope to monitor green mitochondria and red fluorescent nuclear signal.
Inoculate a colony into 3 mL of LB medium with 100 μg/mL ampicillin for miniprep.
Seed 30,000 H2882 cells stably expressing the target antigen H2B-mCherry-RHOBQ63L in each well of 24-well plates.
Transfect 0.75 μg of plasmid DNA with 1.5 μL JetPRIME reagent per well the next day.
Include a negative control (antibody not binding the antigen of interest) in the screen to assess non-degrading effects.
To check the conformational specificity of the hits, perform a counter-screen on a negative cell line using flow cytometry.
